# sebhastian.com

> A comprehensive programming tutorial site specializing in JavaScript, Python, and React with practical code examples and beginner-friendly guides.

Created by Nathan Sebhastian, this site provides in-depth tutorials covering JavaScript fundamentals, array and string manipulation, DOM operations, and modern web development frameworks. The content ranges from beginner guides to intermediate-level programming concepts.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- React
- Python
- Array Methods
- String Manipulation
- Regular Expressions
- Date Formatting
- DOM Operations
- Web Development
- Code Examples
- Beginner Guides
- typeof Operator
- Map Objects
- Express
- Web Tutorials

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://sebhastian.com): Homepage featuring JavaScript, Python, React tutorials and programming guides
- [About](https://sebhastian.com/about): Author bio for Nathan Sebhastian and site overview

## JavaScript Fundamentals

- [JavaScript const Keyword Explained with Examples](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-const): Tutorial explaining const keyword and variable declaration in JavaScript
- [JavaScript Check if Value is an Object](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-check-if-value-is-object): Tutorial on type checking and object detection in JavaScript
- [Sort Keys in Map Using JavaScript](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-sort-keys-in-map): Tutorial on sorting Map object keys in JavaScript using ES6

## Array & String Operations

- [JavaScript Get the Index of Max Value in Array](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-get-index-of-max-value-in-array): Beginner guide to finding max value index in arrays using Math.max()
- [JavaScript Get Sum of Array of Numbers](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-get-sum-of-array-of-numbers): Beginner guide to calculating sum of array numbers using reduce
- [JavaScript Filter Array to Only Numbers](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-filter-array-to-only-numbers): Guide to filtering arrays to include only numeric values
- [JavaScript Array Not Includes a Certain Value](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-array-not-includes): Guide to checking if array excludes specific values using includes()
- [JavaScript Remove Special Characters From a String](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-remove-special-characters-from-string): Tutorial on removing special characters using regular expressions
- [JavaScript Remove Substring From a String](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-remove-substring-from-string): Guide to removing substrings using replace and replaceAll methods
- [JavaScript Replace All Numbers in a String](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-replace-all-numbers-in-string): Tutorial on replacing/removing all numbers using regex patterns
- [JavaScript How To Split String by Index](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-split-string-by-index): Tutorial on splitting strings by index using substring and slice

## Date & Time Operations

- [JavaScript How to Format Date as DD/MM/YYYY](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-format-date-dd-mm-yyyy): Guide to formatting JavaScript dates in DD/MM/YYYY format
- [Convert Milliseconds to Hours Minutes Seconds in JavaScript](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-convert-milliseconds-to-hours-minutes-seconds): Tutorial on converting milliseconds to time format in JavaScript

## DOM & Browser Operations

- [Get Element by Data Attribute Using JavaScript](https://sebhastian.com/javascript-get-element-by-data-attribute): Guide to selecting DOM elements by data attributes using querySelector
- [Auto Refresh Page Every N Seconds in JavaScript](https://sebhastian.com/auto-refresh-page-every-n-seconds-in-javascript): Guide to auto-refreshing web pages using setTimeout and location.reload()
- [You Need to Enable JavaScript to Run This App error in React](https://sebhastian.com/you-need-to-enable-javascript-to-run-this-app): Troubleshooting guide for React JavaScript disabled error
